decisions.decision: Switched from date-fns to native Intl.DateTimeFormat to avoid adding new dependencies and fix Vite 500 errors.
decisions.trade_offs: Native Intl is slightly more verbose but avoids bundle bloat and installation issues.

decisions.decision: Implemented triple-layer protection (Backend RoleGuard, AppRouter ProtectedRoute, and Component-level useAuth check).
decisions.trade_offs: Redundant but ensures maximum security as requested by the user.

decisions.context: M0 Free-Tier Backup & Restore Architecture (TRD Steps 0.1-0.3)
decisions.decision: Atlas M0 Free Tier does not support Atlas Cloud Backup or web console snapshots. All backups, test restores, and staging clones are conducted client-side via node scripts/backup.js with compressed BSON/JSON archives (.gz) outside git tracking.
decisions.trade_offs: Requires local execution and egress bandwidth, but guarantees exact BSON type fidelity and zero cloud cost without requiring paid M10+ tier.

decisions.decision: Pushing to GitHub is strictly reserved for the human administrator. Agent commits locally on phase branches (e.g., phase-0-safety-net, phase-1-additive-schema, phase-2-batch-inference, phase-3-class-consolidation, phase-4-shadow-verification) and never executes git push.
decisions.trade_offs: Prevents accidental CI/CD trigger or auto-deploy to live production.

decisions.decision: Implemented an in-memory 5-second TTL cache for feature flag lookups in server/src/utils/featureFlags.js with instant cache invalidation on mutations.
decisions.trade_offs: Absorbs high-volume traffic spikes while strictly respecting FR-F5 requirement that flag changes take effect within <=10s.

decisions.decision: Used text-layer PDF parsing with honorific stripping, regex table extraction, 'without teacher' exclusions, and explicit Preview -> Commit staging.
decisions.trade_offs: Guarantees zero OCR/ML hallucination, sub-second parsing time (<3s NFR-2), and prevents silent data overwrites.

decisions.decision: Computed batchStartYear = academicStartYear - Math.floor((semester - 1) / 2) with multi-level fallback (student.academicYear -> class.academicYear -> rollNo prefix). BulkWrite in chunks of 500.
decisions.trade_offs: Handles all MITS 4-year cohorts with 100% determinism; chunking avoids memory pressure and connection timeouts on M0 free tier.

decisions.context: Class Identity Consolidation & Referential Integrity (NC-4, NC-6, FR-B1 to FR-B4)
decisions.decision: Primary class is updated in place as the persistent section document with full historical semesterSubjects (status: active/archived). Secondary contributing classes are retired via isActive: false and mergedIntoClassId pointing to primary class, preserving historical approvals and requests. Enforced NC-4 human review gate requiring explicit approved: true.
decisions.trade_offs: Preserves referential integrity for 25k+ approvals while consolidating class model for single-section persistence.

decisions.decision: Shadow comparisons run alongside live operations and log any divergence at warn level with action: 'shadow_mismatch' while unconditionally returning legacy values. Errors in shadow logic are isolated and never disrupt live request execution.
decisions.trade_offs: Zero live regression risk while collecting empirical verification metrics.

decisions.context: Setup Wizard Gating & Persistence (FR-E1 to FR-E4, FR-F3 to FR-F5)
decisions.decision: Enforced strict step ordering (class_info -> timetable_subjects -> students -> mentors -> electives -> preflight -> initiation). Guarded wizard endpoints under 'setup_wizard_enabled' feature flag with <=10s cache invalidation. Block batch initiation unless pre-flight checklist passes.
decisions.trade_offs: Prevents incomplete or corrupted class setups while allowing existing standalone admin pages to operate in parallel without disruption.
